title: Instagram-style grid web UI for photo mode
description: Frontend: responsive photo grid layout, lightbox viewer, profile gallery, stories strip. Can be server-rendered HTML+CSS (like broadside) or SPA. Mobile-first design. Replaces the Mastodon-style timeline when in photo mode.
close_reason: Photo gallery page at /users/{username}/photos in all 3 servers. CSS grid, lazy loading, responsive. Uses fieldwork::util::render_photo_grid + PHOTO_GRID_CSS.
